# Check if anything changed
after = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
before = previous_frame.segmentation['nodes']

# Compare squares
def get_sq_dict(nodes):
    sq = {}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['pixels'] == 16:
            b = n['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            sq[(min_r, min_c)] = n['color']
    return sq

sq_before = get_sq_dict(before)
sq_after = get_sq_dict(after)

changed = []
for pos in sq_before:
    if sq_before[pos] != sq_after.get(pos, '?'):
        changed.append((pos, sq_before[pos], sq_after.get(pos, '?')))

if changed:
    print(f"Squares changed: {changed}")
else:
    print("No squares changed")

# Check small pieces
print("\nSmall pieces (4-8px):")
for n in after:
    if n['pixels'] in [4, 8]:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        print(f"  ({min_r},{min_c}): {n['color']}, {n['pixels']}px")
</parameter>
</function>
